# ABI Companion — AI-readable project index
# Repo: https://github.com/CallmeLanis/VSCode-ABICompanion
# Live demo: https://callmelanis.github.io/VSCode-ABICompanion/

> Arena Breakout Infinite tactical raid-tracking dashboard.
> React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind. Data stored in browser localStorage.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do NOT use github.com repo browser URLs — they are JavaScript-rendered and unreadable to crawlers.
- Use raw.githubusercontent.com links above, or the live demo for UI behavior.
- This is a local-first app: no backend required; Supabase dep exists but is not wired yet.
- Visual identity: tactical AAA game HUD (Arena Breakout / Tarkov style), Oxanium font, warm dark palette.
